name: v0.1.8
body:
## What's Changed
* 463b68b NUT-08 by @BilligsterUser in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/42
* 540cfad  mint: log mint server's listening address (ip:port) at start by @theStack in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/45
* c6485ce  fix crash of `pay` command if no argument is provided by @theStack in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/43
* c74ddb4 typo by @thesimplekid in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/46
* a1e1c43 [Mint] add keyest id to blind sigs by @callebtc in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/48
* 5a7f52a mint: simplify `AmountSplit` by iterating over amount bits by @theStack in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/44

## New Contributors
* @BilligsterUser made their first contribution in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/42
* @theStack made their first contribution in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/45
* @thesimplekid made their first contribution in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/46
* @callebtc made their first contribution in https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/pull/48

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-feni/compare/v0.1.7...v0.1.8
